title: The masking-profile operations, the PII read record and the view-column naming of a masking_rule row are not specified in any source
description: Three values the story needs have no source. (1) No masking-profile operation has a row in the ownership map or in TSD P4 v3 appendix T-A, whose only access reads are API-P4-007 GET /admin/roles and API-P4-008 GET /admin/access-log, and the legacy Endpoints table names only the reference-load load and approve operations, which belong to RWB-P4-AD010-APP and RWB-P4-E1037-APP. (2) The PII log of legacy AC2 has no producer, record name or field list: Architecture v5 slide 20 and TSD P4 v3 T5.1 INT-22 place PII Kafka, audit and SOC logging with ACE Common, not in rwb_access, so no table of the service carries the unmask read. (3) masking_rule carries field_id (DF-REF-200) and no view or column column, while the legacy guardrail requires a masking rule to name the view column the masked value comes from, so the naming rule has to be realised through the field id resolved against the P1 field registry.
source: Legacy RWB-AD-004 Endpoints, Permission checks and Guardrails; TSD P4 v3 T3.1 (masking_rule DF-REF-198 to DF-REF-204) and appendix T-A.1; Ownership Map v1; FSD P4 v3 A2.5; Architecture v5 slide 20; TSD P4 v3 T5.1 INT-22
section: Legacy RWB-AD-004 Endpoints and Guardrails; TSD P4 v3 T3.1 and T-A.1; Ownership Map v1
evidence: TSD P4 v3 T-A.1 lists API-P4-004 to API-P4-021 and none is a masking-profile operation; the Ownership Map has no masking API row. Architecture v5 slide 20: every service calls ACE Common audit and PII logging. TSD P4 v3 T5.1 INT-22: PII Kafka, audit and SOC logs, direction out, ACE logging, as they happen. Legacy RWB-AD-004 Guardrails: A masking rule names a view column, and no rule returns the clear identity number. TSD P4 v3 T3.1 masking_rule: id, role_code, field_id, unmasked, masking_version, valid_from, valid_to only.
proposed: Fix the three operations on /api/recovery/access/v1 with the Reference data R and C rights of TSD P4 v3 T6.1 and the unmasked rule as the unmask right, write the unmask read through the ACE Common PII logging client, and resolve the view and column of a rule through the field id of the P1 field registry; add no view-name column to masking_rule and no PII table to rwb_access.

title: The masking-profile contract shapes, the unmask record, the page default and the view-column naming have no source definition
description: The contract baseline fixes four schemas, a page, an unmask request and an unmask record that no source defines. masking_rule fixes only its seven columns (DF-REF-198 to DF-REF-204) and no answer shape; the ownership map and TSD P4 v3 appendix T-A give the three operations no path and no right; the legacy guardrail requires a rule to name a view column but the table has no view or column column; and the PII record of the unmask has no producer or field list because the log is ACE Common's. The page default and maximum and the field names of MaskingProfile, MaskingProfileRow, MaskingProfileVersion and MaskingProfilePage are therefore this revision's decision, taken to match the page shape of RWB-P4-AD001-CON section 12.1.
source: TSD P4 v3 T3.1 (masking_rule DF-REF-198 to DF-REF-204) and appendix T-A.1; Ownership Map v1; legacy RWB-AD-004 Guardrails and Data; Architecture v5 slides 14 and 20; TSD P4 v3 T5.1 INT-22; RWB-P4-AD001-CON section 12.1
section: TSD P4 v3 T3.1 and T-A.1; legacy RWB-AD-004 Data and Guardrails; contract sections 11 and 12
evidence: TSD P4 v3 T3.1 masking_rule has no status, view or column column. TSD P4 v3 T-A.1 has no masking-profile path. Architecture v5 slide 14 names /masking-policies without a path; slide 20 keeps audit and PII logging with ACE Common. Legacy RWB-AD-004 Guardrails: A masking rule names a view column, and no rule returns the clear identity number. RWB-P4-AD001-CON 12.1 fixes a page of 50 by default and 200 at most for the same service.
proposed: Publish the four schemas with roleCode, fieldId, viewName, columnName, unmasked, maskingVersion, validFrom and validTo on the profile, a page of 50 by default and 200 at most, and an unmask record that names the case, the person key, the field, the view and column, the version, the role, the acting user reference and the time with no clear value; refer the PII record itself to ACE Common and the view and column to the P1 field registry.
